newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea targets '97 rice output at 4.87 mln tns.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea targets '97 rice output at 4.87 mln tns.

text.p: South Korea targets 1997 rice output at 4.87 million tonnes against 5.32 million in 1996, an official at the Agriculture and Forestry Ministry said on Thursday.
"The rice harvest this year was exceptionally good due to favorable weather, but we don't expect such a condition to continue into next year," the official said.
This year's healthy harvest was also behind a sharp slowdown in the decline in area under rice paddy.

The loss of land used for rice cultivation in 1997 is projected at 5,000 hectares from a year ago, leaving the total rice area at 1,045,000 hectares. The ministry said 6,000 hectares were lost this year.
The yield from 10 acres (4 hectares) of rice paddy would be 466 kgs in 1997, compared with 507 kgs this year, he said.
